purpose: Free-first thumbnail production policy for Pattern Lab city-history thumbnails.

source URL or local source path

hard_blocks: paid tool used without owner approval
paid asset used without owner approval

workflow: OpenClaw free source/assets -> local enhancement/cutout readiness -> OCR/readability and benchmark scoring -> 20 roughs -> 8 shortlisted -> 5 owner-review concepts -> 3 production candidates -> owner approval before any upload or replacement.

allowed: generic map texture or route glow
generic city-underground tunnel or sewer image when not presented as source proof
generic partial-redaction document prop with fictional text
blocked: AI city hero replacing available rights-safe real city imagery
derivative copy of an unlicensed internet reference
copy of another creator thumbnail layout
generic support image represented as being from the active city
support image that can be identified as another specific city but is used as the active city
ai_support_asset_policy.reference_rule: Unlicensed internet images may be used only to extract generic written art direction, never as a copied/traced/near-duplicate reference output.

blocked_uses: fake city-specific skyline when real city hero imagery is available
